'''July 2001 Tustin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Squeeze Play, Tustin, California on 8 July 2001. [[Andy Chen]] won it. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2610">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-longshot-in-tustin-ca-7-8-01d2610/ longshot-in-tustin-ca-7-8-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 9 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-longshot-in-tustin-ca-7-8-01d2610/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Squeeze Play, Tustin, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy Chen]]
